resolutions.title: The archive's `SHALL carry a continuation entry` is unsatisfiable when no independent pass precedes the override
resolutions.action: Settled the edge in the requirement rather than leaving it to be discovered. `specs/orbit-archive-modifications/spec.md` gained THE ONE EDGE WHERE THE SUCCESSOR CANNOT BE WRITTEN: when no independent pass precedes the emit, the entry is OMITTED and `gate_overridden` stands alone — a record cannot be formed against evidence that does not exist, and inventing a token is refused by the ordering check. Carried the measurement into the prose (20 overrides across every archived change, all 20 with an earlier independent pass) so the edge reads as unobserved-but-named rather than hypothetical, and stated plainly that the stage retiring `gate_overridden` must HANDLE a domain the successor provably cannot cover. Added the matching scenario, and mirrored one clause into the archive body's Step 3.4 so an author at the seam is told to omit rather than improvise.

resolutions.action: Fixed, and it surfaced the pre-existing divergence the instrument argument predicted. Added `review-external` -> `external-handoff.md` to the parity REFERENCES table with `awaiting_findings` declared engine-owned. The test then FAILED on `reviewer_class`, which the block documented but the payload table REFUSES as an unknown key and the engine never composes — verified against a real trail emit (`review-external-2026-09-21T19-28-17Z.json` has no such field). final_assessment: The trailing in-context pass walked to zero: 7 findings, 0 CRITICAL, all resolved, none stale, none deferred. Five of the seven were residue of the blind-pair walk two hours earlier — the same shape five times, a fix landing where the reviewer pointed and stopping at the edge of its class — and the walk that fixed them produced one more instance of the class in flight: appending D-rc04-19 invalidated the decision count that the previous walk had just corrected, caught by the ripple check and swept. Two findings were not residue. The archive's continuation SHALL is now a named edge rather than an unsatisfiable requirement, with the measurement (20 overrides, all 20 citable) carried into the prose so rc04c inherits a handled case instead of a discovery. And F6's fix surfaced a pre-existing defect the instrument argument predicted exactly: `external-handoff.md` documented `reviewer_class`, which the payload table refuses and the engine never composes, so the schema reference had been leading authors into a refused emit for as long as it existed — invisible because that reference was the one schema block no parity instrument read.
